facts.fact: Wavemaker's pipeline storyboards a photo-based video across one of 21 presets, according to the vendor's own page.
facts.quote: storyboards it across one of 21 presets, adds motion to your stills

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, most photo-to-video outputs are completed in two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos land in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, exports go up to 4K on paid plans, while the free tier exports at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: Export up to 4K on paid plans. The free tier exports at 480p with a watermark

facts.fact: Third-party source Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video Marketing survey reported that 89% of consumers said watching a video convinced them to buy a product or service.
facts.quote: In Wyzowl's 2024 survey, 89% of consumers said watching a video convinced them to buy a product or service

facts.fact: Adwave states that a 30-second video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks starting at $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.
facts.quote: the same 30-second video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, from $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.

facts.fact: Adwave states that the free Wavemaker plan includes 75 credits, enough for a first video, with 480p export and a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits, enough for your first video, with a 480p export and a watermark.

facts.fact: Adwave states that paid Wavemaker plans start at $29 per month for up to 1080p export, no watermark, and more credits.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo for up to 1080p, no watermark, and more credits, with up to 4K on higher tiers.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a curated set of about a dozen sharp, varied photos usually produces a stronger video than a few near-duplicates or a huge unfiltered dump.
facts.quote: A dozen or so sharp, varied photos usually produce a stronger video than a few near-duplicates or a huge unfiltered dump.

facts.fact: Adwave states Wavemaker has no strict minimum number of photos required.
facts.quote: There's no strict minimum, but a curated set works best.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Wavemaker's pipeline adds motion to stills, writes and records a voiceover, builds connective visuals, keeps recurring subjects consistent, scores with BPM-aware music, and runs an AI vision QC pass.
facts.quote: The pipeline adds motion to your stills, writes and records a voiceover, builds connective visuals, keeps recurring subjects consistent, scores it with BPM-aware music, and runs an AI vision QC pass before delivery.
